rationale: One conditional structural redesign survives. It narrows the beachhead to heat-pump and building-control product lines, makes a signed embedded-integrator channel commitment a pre-delivery gate, deploys in the customer cloud, and sells versioned mappings, automated release tests, access logs and evidence as product-line release assurance rather than monetizing commodity transport. This directly addresses the diagnosed distribution, gross-margin and reproducibility limits while preserving the same Data Act scope and responsibility boundaries. No buyer, partner, reuse, retention or payback evidence is invented: a signed partner commitment, prepaid OEM statement of work, measured first implementation and paid second-line reuse remain required validation.
